units.source_text: 古歌：“怪哉心头事，越憎爱越深。

en.t: An old poem says: Strange are the matters of the heart; the more one hates, the deeper love grows.

units.source_text: 谁能操利刃，斩断此情根？”

en.t: Who can take up a sharp blade and cut off the root of this feeling?
This appears in the Later Collection of Japanese Poems.
